--// Made by @DirectMemoryAccess
local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")

local Settings = {
    Farming = {
        Enabled      = true,
        AutoStart    = true,
        RefreshRate  = 0.3,
        TweenSpeed   = 14,
        MaxDistance  = 1.2,
        MaxDuration  = 3.5,
        MinDuration  = 0.6,
        FollowOffset = 4,
        PhotoRange   = 10,
        MaxAttempts  = 60,
    }
}

local S = Settings.Farming

--// tasks
local AREA_TASKS = {
    { canonical = "Rooftop",                   aliases = { "rooftop", "roof" } },
    { canonical = "Courtyard",                 aliases = { "courtyard", "court yard" } },
    { canonical = "Cafeteria",                 aliases = { "cafeteria", "cafe", "lunch room", "lunchroom" } },
    { canonical = "Basketball Court",          aliases = { "basketball court", "basketball", "bball court" } },
    { canonical = "Dojo Room",                 aliases = { "dojo room", "dojo" } },
    { canonical = "Music Room",                aliases = { "music room", "music" } },
    { canonical = "Parking Lot",               aliases = { "parking lot", "parking", "car park" } },
    { canonical = "Nishikata High Entrance",   aliases = { "nishikata high entrance", "school entrance", "entrance", "nishikata entrance", "high entrance", "school front", "front entrance" } },
    { canonical = "Infirmary",                 aliases = { "infirmary", "nurse office", "nurse's office", "medical room" } },
    { canonical = "Study Room",                aliases = { "study room", "study", "library" } },
    { canonical = "Lounge",                    aliases = { "lounge" } },
    { canonical = "GAKUMART",                  aliases = { "gakumart", "mart", "store", "shop" } },
    { canonical = "Nishikata District",        aliases = { "nishikata district", "district", "nishikata" } },
}

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character, HRP, Humanoid

local phoneScreenPush = nil
local photoJobSubmit  = nil

local State = {
    farming    = false,
    processing = false,
    following  = false,
    tweening   = false,
    lastTask   = "",
    taskCount  = 0,
}

local followConnection = nil
local currentTween     = nil

--// handler
local function bindCharacter(char)
    Character = char
    HRP       = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    Humanoid  = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    if followConnection then
        followConnection:Disconnect()
        followConnection = nil
        State.following  = false
    end
    if currentTween then
        currentTween:Cancel()
        currentTween   = nil
        State.tweening = false
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = true end
    end
end

local Util = {}

function Util.findRemotes()
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not remotes then return false end
    phoneScreenPush = remotes:FindFirstChild("PhoneScreenPush")
    photoJobSubmit  = remotes:FindFirstChild("PhotoJobSubmit")
    return phoneScreenPush ~= nil and photoJobSubmit ~= nil
end

function Util.startPhotoJob()
    if not photoJobSubmit then return end
    pcall(photoJobSubmit.InvokeServer, photoJobSubmit, "Start")
    task.wait(0.5)
end

function Util.setCollision(enabled)
    if not Character then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = enabled end
    end
end

function Util.cancelActiveTween()
    if currentTween then
        currentTween:Cancel()
        currentTween = nil
    end
    State.tweening = false
end

--// tween functions
function Util.smoothTween(targetPos)
    if not HRP then return end
    Util.cancelActiveTween()

    local origin = HRP.Position
    local dist   = (targetPos - origin).Magnitude

    if dist < S.MaxDistance then
        HRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
        Util.setCollision(true)
        return
    end

    Util.setCollision(false)
    State.tweening = true

    local duration = math.clamp(dist / S.TweenSpeed, S.MinDuration, S.MaxDuration)
    local midPos   = origin:Lerp(targetPos, 0.55)

    local phase1 = TweenService:Create(
        HRP,
        TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
        { CFrame = CFrame.new(midPos) }
    )
    local phase2 = TweenService:Create(
        HRP,
        TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) }
    )

    currentTween = phase1
    phase1:Play()
    phase1.Completed:Wait()

    if not State.farming then
        Util.cancelActiveTween()
        Util.setCollision(true)
        return
    end

    currentTween = phase2
    phase2:Play()
    phase2.Completed:Wait()
    currentTween = nil

    Util.setCollision(true)
    State.tweening = false
    task.wait(0.08)
end

function Util.fastFollowTween(targetPos)
    if not HRP or State.tweening then return end
    State.tweening = true
    Util.setCollision(false)

    local dist = (targetPos - HRP.Position).Magnitude
    local dur  = math.clamp(dist / (S.TweenSpeed * 1.6), 0.25, 1.4)

    if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
    currentTween = TweenService:Create(
        HRP,
        TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) }
    )
    currentTween:Play()
    currentTween.Completed:Wait()
    currentTween   = nil
    State.tweening = false
end

--// photo functions
function Util.takePhoto(targetPos)
    if not phoneScreenPush or not photoJobSubmit or not HRP then return end

    local buf = buffer.create(7)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 0, 1)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 1, 4)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 2, 0)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 3, 1)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 4, 1)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 5, 42)
    buffer.writeu8(buf, 6, 24)

    pcall(phoneScreenPush.FireServer, phoneScreenPush, buf)
    task.wait(0.15)

    local lookAt = targetPos or (HRP.Position + HRP.CFrame.LookVector * 10)
    pcall(photoJobSubmit.InvokeServer, photoJobSubmit, "Submit", CFrame.new(HRP.Position, lookAt))
    task.wait(0.15)
end

--// find functions
function Util.findPlayer(name)
    local low = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            if p.Name:lower():find(low, 1, true) or p.DisplayName:lower():find(low, 1, true) then
                if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    return p
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function fuzzyScore(haystack, needle)
    local score = 0
    for word in needle:gmatch("%S+") do
        if #word > 2 and haystack:find(word, 1, true) then
            score = score + 1
        end
    end
    return score
end

function Util.normalizeTaskText(raw)
    return raw
        :gsub("^get a photo of ", "")
        :gsub("^a photo of ", "")
        :gsub("^photo of ", "")
        :gsub("^the ", "")
        :lower()
        :match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

function Util.resolveCanonical(normalized)
    for _, entry in ipairs(AREA_TASKS) do
        for _, alias in ipairs(entry.aliases) do
            if normalized == alias then
                return entry.canonical
            end
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(AREA_TASKS) do
        for _, alias in ipairs(entry.aliases) do
            if normalized:find(alias, 1, true) or alias:find(normalized, 1, true) then
                return entry.canonical
            end
        end
    end

    local bestScore    = 0
    local bestCanonical = nil
    for _, entry in ipairs(AREA_TASKS) do
        for _, alias in ipairs(entry.aliases) do
            local s = fuzzyScore(alias, normalized) + fuzzyScore(normalized, alias)
            if s > bestScore then
                bestScore     = s
                bestCanonical = entry.canonical
            end
        end
    end
    if bestScore > 0 then return bestCanonical end

    return nil
end

function Util.findLocation(raw)
    local normalized = Util.normalizeTaskText(raw)
    local canonical  = Util.resolveCanonical(normalized)

    local searchTerms = {}
    if canonical then
        table.insert(searchTerms, canonical:lower())
    end
    table.insert(searchTerms, normalized)

    for word in normalized:gmatch("%S+") do
        if #word > 3 then
            table.insert(searchTerms, word)
        end
    end

    local bestPart  = nil
    local bestScore = 0

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            local objName = obj.Name:lower()

            for _, term in ipairs(searchTerms) do
                if objName:find(term, 1, true) then
                    local s = fuzzyScore(objName, term) + 1
                    if s > bestScore then
                        bestScore = s
                        bestPart  = obj
                    end
                end
            end

            local lm = obj:FindFirstChild("PhotoJobLandmark")
            if lm and lm.Value then
                local lmVal = lm.Value:lower()
                for _, term in ipairs(searchTerms) do
                    if lmVal:find(term, 1, true) then
                        local s = fuzzyScore(lmVal, term) + 2
                        if s > bestScore then
                            bestScore = s
                            bestPart  = obj
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestPart and bestPart.Position or nil
end

--// gui functions
function Util.getTaskText()
    local gui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not gui then return nil end
    local jobGui = gui:FindFirstChild("PhotoJobGui")
    if not jobGui then return nil end
    local card = jobGui:FindFirstChild("Card")
    if not card then return nil end
    local label = card:FindFirstChild("Task")
    if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then return nil end
    return label.Text
end

local function isKnownArea(text)
    local low = text:lower()
    for _, entry in ipairs(AREA_TASKS) do
        for _, alias in ipairs(entry.aliases) do
            if low:find(alias, 1, true) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

--// task handlers
local function handlePlayerTask(playerName)
    local targetPlayer = Util.findPlayer(playerName)
    if not targetPlayer then return end

    State.following = true

    followConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not State.following or not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
            State.following = false
            return
        end

        local tRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tRoot or not HRP then return end

        local goal = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(S.FollowOffset, 0, S.FollowOffset)
        if (goal - HRP.Position).Magnitude > 3 then
            Util.fastFollowTween(goal)
        end

        if HRP then
            HRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(HRP.Position, tRoot.Position)
        end
    end)

    local attempts   = 0
    local photoTaken = false

    while attempts < S.MaxAttempts and State.farming and State.following do
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
            targetPlayer = Util.findPlayer(playerName)
            if not targetPlayer then break end
        end

        local tRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and HRP then
            if (tRoot.Position - HRP.Position).Magnitude < S.PhotoRange then
                Util.cancelActiveTween()
                Util.setCollision(true)
                Util.takePhoto(tRoot.Position)
                photoTaken = true
                break
            end
        end

        task.wait(0.3)
        attempts += 1
    end

    State.following = false
    if followConnection then
        followConnection:Disconnect()
        followConnection = nil
    end

    Util.setCollision(true)
    State.tweening = false

    if not photoTaken and targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
        local tRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot then
            Util.smoothTween(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(S.FollowOffset, 0, S.FollowOffset))
            task.wait(0.2)
            Util.takePhoto(tRoot.Position)
        end
    end
end

local function handleLocationTask(taskText)
    local pos = Util.findLocation(taskText)
    if not pos then return end
    Util.smoothTween(pos)
    task.wait(0.2)
    Util.takePhoto(pos)
end

--// process task
local function processTask()
    if State.processing or not State.farming then return end

    local taskText = Util.getTaskText()
    if not taskText or taskText == "" or taskText == "Waiting for assignment..." then return end
    if taskText == State.lastTask then return end

    State.lastTask   = taskText
    State.processing = true
    State.taskCount += 1

    local low           = taskText:lower()
    local hasPhotoOf    = low:find("get a photo of ") ~= nil
    local hasThe        = low:find(" the ") ~= nil or low:find("^the ") ~= nil
    local knownArea     = isKnownArea(taskText)
    local hasPlayer     = low:find("player") ~= nil

    local isPlayerTask  = hasPlayer or (hasPhotoOf and not hasThe and not knownArea)

    if isPlayerTask then
        local playerName = taskText
            :gsub("^get a photo of ", "")
            :gsub("^a photo of ", "")
            :gsub("^photo of ", "")
        handlePlayerTask(playerName)
    else
        handleLocationTask(taskText)
    end

    Util.setCollision(true)
    State.tweening = false
    task.wait(0.5)

    State.processing = false
    State.lastTask   = ""
end

--// farm loop
local function farmLoop()
    while State.farming do
        if not State.processing then processTask() end
        task.wait(S.RefreshRate)
    end
end

--// setup
local initChar = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
bindCharacter(initChar)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)

--// main
task.spawn(function()
    local tries = 0
    while not Util.findRemotes() and tries < 10 do
        task.wait(1)
        tries += 1
    end
    Util.startPhotoJob()
    if S.AutoStart then
        State.farming = true
        task.spawn(farmLoop)
    end
end)

--// global functions
_G.StopFarming = function()
    State.farming    = false
    State.following  = false
    State.tweening   = false
    State.processing = false
    if followConnection then followConnection:Disconnect(); followConnection = nil end
    if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel(); currentTween = nil end
    Util.setCollision(true)
end

_G.StartFarming = function()
    if State.farming then return end
    State.farming    = true
    State.processing = false
    State.following  = false
    State.tweening   = false
    State.lastTask   = ""
    State.taskCount  = 0
    Util.setCollision(true)
    task.spawn(farmLoop)
end

_G.GetStatus = function()
    return State
end
